subtitle: דלאלהֵ אלחאירין — The Guide of the Perplexed
author: Moses Maimonides (1138–1204)
intro: Ram ('high') and nissa ('lifted up') each signify both elevation of place and elevation of rank — majesty, honor, and might. Of God only the latter is meant: 'thus saith the high and lofty One' (Isa 57:15) is loftiness of rank, majesty, and might, not loftiness of place. Maimonides anticipates an objection — how can many notions be made one? — and previews that for the perfected, God's manifold attributes of greatness, might, power, perfection, and bounty all reduce to a single notion: His essence, nothing outside it. Hover a phrase to see its English light up; tap any word for a gloss; dotted words are key terms.

terms.note: Each equivocal between elevation of place and elevation of rank. Of God, only elevation of rank — majesty, honor, might — is intended.
Majesty (jalāla), honor (karāma), and might (ʿizza). 'Be Thou exalted, O God, above the heavens' (Ps 57:6) — loftiness of rank, not of place.

For the perfected apprehenders, God is not described by many attributes: the many descriptions that signify greatness, might, power, perfection, and bounty all return to one notion — His essence, nothing external to it.
The single notion to which all the attributes reduce: His essence itself, not a thing outside the essence. Chapters on the names and attributes will follow.

aligned.ja: אלג'ז אלאול · אלפצל אלעשרון — רם ונשא
aligned.en: Part One · Chapter Twenty — Ram & Nissa

aligned.ja: רם הו אסם משתרך למעני ארתפאע אלמכאן ומעני ארתפאע אלמנזלה, אעני אלג'לאלה ואלכראמה ואלעזה. קאל: ותרם התבה מעל הארץ — והד'א מן אלמעני אלאול.
aligned.en: Ram is an equivocal noun, for the sense of elevation of place and the sense of elevation of rank — I mean majesty, honor, and might. He said: 'and the ark was lifted up above the earth' (Gen 7:17) — and this is of the first sense.

pairs.ja: רם הו אסם משתרך למעני ארתפאע אלמכאן ומעני ארתפאע אלמנזלה
pairs.en: Ram is an equivocal noun, for the sense of elevation of place and the sense of elevation of rank
I mean majesty, honor, and might
and the ark was lifted up above the earth
and this is of the first sense

aligned.ja: וקאל: הרימותי בחור מעם, יען אשר הרימותיך מן העפר, יען אשר הרימותיך מתוך העם — מן אלמעני אלת'אני.
aligned.en: And He said: 'I have exalted one chosen out of the people' (Ps 89:20); 'forasmuch as I exalted thee out of the dust' (1 Kgs 16:2); 'forasmuch as I exalted thee from among the people' (1 Kgs 14:7) — of the second sense.

pairs.en: I have exalted one chosen out of the people
forasmuch as I exalted thee out of the dust
forasmuch as I exalted thee from among the people
of the second sense

aligned.ja: וכל לפט' הרמה ג'א פי אללה הו מן הד'א אלמעני אלת'אני: רומה על השמים אלהים.
aligned.en: And every expression of 'exalting' that comes regarding God is of this second sense: 'be Thou exalted, O God, above the heavens' (Ps 57:6).

pairs.ja: וכל לפט' הרמה ג'א פי אללה הו מן הד'א אלמעני אלת'אני
pairs.en: And every expression of 'exalting' that comes regarding God is of this second sense
be Thou exalted, O God, above the heavens

aligned.ja: וכד'לך נשא יכון במעני רפעהֵ אלמכאן ובמעני רפעהֵ אלמנזלה וופור אלחט': וישאו את שברם על חמוריהם — מן אלמעני אלאול, ומת'לה כת'יר פי מעני אלחמל ואלנקלאן, לאנה רפעה פי אלמוצ'ע.
aligned.en: And likewise nissa bears the sense of raising in place and the sense of raising in rank and abundance of fortune: 'and they laded their corn upon their asses' (Gen 42:26) — of the first sense, and there are many like it in the sense of carrying and conveying, for it is a raising in place.

pairs.ja: וכד'לך נשא יכון במעני רפעהֵ אלמכאן ובמעני רפעהֵ אלמנזלה וופור אלחט'
pairs.en: And likewise nissa bears the sense of raising in place and the sense of raising in rank and abundance of fortune
and they laded their corn upon their asses
of the first sense

pairs.ja: ומת'לה כת'יר פי מעני אלחמל ואלנקלאן
pairs.en: and there are many like it in the sense of carrying and conveying
for it is a raising in place

aligned.ja: ומן אלמעני אלת'אני: ותנשא מלכותו, וינטלם וינשאם, ומדוע תתנשאו.
aligned.en: And of the second sense: 'and his kingdom shall be exalted' (Num 24:7); 'and He bore them and carried them' (Isa 63:9); 'wherefore then lift ye up yourselves' (Num 16:3).

pairs.en: And of the second sense
and his kingdom shall be exalted
and He bore them and carried them
wherefore then lift ye up yourselves

aligned.ja: פכל לשון נשיאה ג'את מנסובה ללה תעאלי הי מן הד'א אלמעני אלאכ'יר: הנשא שופט הארץ, כה אמר רם ונשא — רפעה וג'לאלה ועזה, לא עלו מכאן.
aligned.en: So every expression of 'lifting up' that comes ascribed to God, may He be exalted, is of this last sense: 'lift up Thyself, Thou judge of the earth' (Ps 94:2); 'thus saith the high and lofty One' (Isa 57:15) — loftiness, majesty, and might, not loftiness of place.

pairs.ja: פכל לשון נשיאה ג'את מנסובה ללה תעאלי הי מן הד'א אלמעני אלאכ'יר
pairs.en: So every expression of 'lifting up' that comes ascribed to God, may He be exalted, is of this last sense
lift up Thyself, Thou judge of the earth
thus saith the high and lofty One

pairs.ja: רפעה וג'לאלה ועזה, לא עלו מכאן
pairs.en: loftiness, majesty, and might, not loftiness of place

aligned.ja: ולעל ישכל עליך קולי רפעהֵ מנזלה וג'לאלה ועזה, פתקול: כיף תג'על מעאני כת'ירה מן מעני ואחד? סיבין לך אן אללה תעאלי ענד אלמדרכין אלכאמלין לא יוצף באוצאף כת'ירה.
aligned.en: Perhaps my words 'loftiness of rank, majesty, and might' will trouble you, and you will say: how do you make many notions of a single notion? It will be explained to you that God, may He be exalted, is, for the perfected apprehenders, not described by many attributes.

pairs.en: Perhaps my words 'loftiness of rank, majesty, and might' will trouble you

pairs.en: and you will say: how do you make many notions of a single notion?

aligned.ja: ואן הד'ה אלאוצאף כלהא אלמתעדדה אלתי תדל עלי אלתעט'ים ואלעזה ואלקדרה ואלכמאל ואלג'וד וגירהא כלהא תרג'ע למעני ואחד, וד'לך אלמעני הו ד'אתה, לא שי כ'ארג' ען אלד'את. וסתאתיך פצול פי אלאסמא ואלצפאת.
aligned.en: And that all these manifold descriptions — which signify magnification, might, power, perfection, bounty, and the rest — all return to a single notion; and that notion is His essence, not a thing outside the essence. And chapters on the names and the attributes will come to you.

aligned.ja: ואנמא אלקצד פי הד'א אלפצל אן רם ונשא ליס מענאה ומפהומה עלו מכאן, בל עלו מנזלה.
aligned.en: The aim of this chapter is only that 'high and lifted up' does not mean, and is not to be understood as, loftiness of place, but loftiness of rank.
